description: Derde Helmersstraat 54-64 (1899-1900): 6 m red-brown brick fronts of four storeys under a thin cornice at 14.3 m; three axes of two-light windows with a transom under segmental brick heads on every storey; white sills; iron balconettes on bracketed slabs on the centre axis of storeys 2-3; over the two right-hand axes a brick wall dormer one storey high with two arched lights and a crenellated (merlon) parapet; a small timber dormer on the left axis

merlon-dormer.note: 54-64: a brick wall dormer over the two right-hand axes, 3.4 m over the cornice, two lights, merlon parapet

door-left.note: 58, 60: arched house door on the left axis

rhythm.identicalBays: every storey: 3 windows with a transom under segmental heads
rhythm.symmetry: upper storeys symmetric; the wall dormer on the right two axes
rhythm.roofline: thin cornice at 14.3 m; a crenellated brick wall dormer over two axes
